title: A home for GSoC 2026 contributors
summary:
A GSoC contributor hub, TwinFlow image-generation work, and a new entry tier led the day; MCP model lists stopped keeping five-minute-old answers around.

A GSoC 2026 app was added with project ideas, mentor profiles, a timeline, FAQs, and guidance that points contributors toward project-specific issues. The ideas range from gaming SDKs and a CLI to a platform health agent and a multimodal semantic cache.

A TwinFlow-Z-Image-Turbo server was added with aspect-ratio-preserving scaling up to 1280×1280 pixels and a five-step default. The Flux Schnell server also switched to FP4 weights for RTX 5090 GPUs.

Microbe was added to the tier configuration at 0.1 Pollen per day. Enter’s tier panel and Hello page now describe five tiers, with Microbe as the entry tier and Spore as verified; signup and verification logic did not change.
